basis: [bain_capital_heritage] Another desk (decisions.md D2, R1): Eschelon Telecom's IPO prospectus (424B1, 2005-08-04) names Bain Capital Fund VI, L.P. (general partner Bain Capital Partners VI under Bain Capital Investors, LLC) and its BCIP co-investment entities as the Bain holder, bought in rounds from 1999 (Mark Nunnelly on the board from September 1999, Ian Loring from 2001, both private-equity managing directors), with no venture vehicle. Fund VI, Wind Point and Stolberg together held 88% before the IPO. A generalist-fund position, not BCV's, although the firm listed it in 2006-2013.

CTC Communications Group was listed on NASDAQ when Bain Capital Fund VI, L.P. bought 75,000 shares of its convertible preferred stock (Schedule 13D of 2000-05-26, beside Thomas H. Lee Equity Fund IV), with Mark Nunnelly joining the board in June 2000 (CTC's 2001 proxy). A placement into a listed company is not a venture round (COLLECTION.md s1 T3; decisions.md D4), and the holder was a generalist fund, not a BCV vehicle (D2).
